svg.title: Weather official webpage — observed viewport
svg.desc: Native E-WEATHER-WEB reference. Editable browser/site headers, cookie paragraph and visible body labels. Public wordmark and banner are raster crops; banner heading and cursor remain raster. Figma imported text uses Inter fallback; first Cookie line reduced to22px to avoid clipping. Approximate fonts/icons, omitted cookie translucency/obscured underlying content. Only observed viewport; no invented full page or unobserved browser/cookie outcomes.
svg.text: Applicable to ALL online and face-to-face

g.text: We use Cookies to give you a better experience on
our website. By continuing to browse the site
without changing your privacy settings, you are
consenting to our use of Cookies. For more
information, please see our Privacy Policy
